title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
task: Taxonomy and evaluation framework for environment modeling in autonomous agents
key_results: Synthesized 400+ works across 100+ systems; proposed levels×laws framework (L1-L3 capabilities, 4 law regimes); outlined decision-centric evaluation principles
comments: Comprehensive review providing essential conceptual structure for the fragmented world-modeling literature, though inherently descriptive rather than empirically novel.

title: Video Analysis and Generation via a Semantic Progress Function
task: Analyzing and correcting non-linear semantic evolution in video generation
key_results: Semantic Progress Function enables detection of uneven pacing; semantic linearization produces smoother transitions with constant-rate semantic change
comments: Model-agnostic approach is elegant but evaluation on generation quality metrics would strengthen claims beyond the conceptual framework.

model_io.model: Semantic embedding extractor + curve fitting

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video generation exhibits non-linear semantic evolution with abrupt jumps
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; semantic linearization produces more coherent transitions

title: DiffNR: Diffusion-Enhanced Neural Representation Optimization for Sparse-View 3D Tomographic Reconstruction
task: Sparse-view 3D CT reconstruction using neural representations with diffusion priors
key_results: 3.99 dB average PSNR improvement; generalizes across domains; maintains efficient optimization with single-step diffusion model
comments: Clever integration of diffusion priors avoids expensive iterative denoising, but evaluation limited to standard CT benchmarks without clinical validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-step diffusion repair with periodic pseudo-reference supervision outperforms iterative diffusion-embedded solvers

title: LLM Safety From Within: Detecting Harmful Content with Internal Representations
task: Detecting harmful content using internal LLM representations without guard model modifications
key_results: Outperforms state-of-the-art guard models; 250× fewer trainable parameters; superior generalization to unseen benchmarks
comments: Elegant approach exploiting internal structure, but only tested on text safety—unclear how well this scales to multimodal harmful content detection.

model_io.model: SIREN (lightweight guard model via linear probing + adaptive layer-weighting)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Safety-relevant features in internal LLM layers provide better detection than terminal representations alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across multiple benchmarks

title: FlowAnchor: Stabilizing the Editing Signal for Inversion-Free Video Editing
task: Stable inversion-free flow-based video editing via anchored editing signals
key_results: Faithful, temporally coherent editing in multi-object and fast-motion scenes; improved computational efficiency vs. inversion methods
comments: Addresses real practical bottleneck (editing signal instability in high-dimensional video latent space), though quantitative metrics on temporal consistency are missing.

outputs: edited video frames with temporal coherence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stabilizing editing signal location and magnitude improves multi-object video editing quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with qualitative results; quantitative temporal metrics needed

title: AgentSearchBench: A Benchmark for AI Agent Search in the Wild
task: Discovering and ranking suitable AI agents given task descriptions or executable queries
key_results: Large-scale benchmark from ~10k real-world agents; identified semantic-to-performance gap; lightweight behavioral signals improve ranking substantially
comments: Highlights underexplored agent discovery problem, but relies on real-world agent metadata that may be incomplete or uneven in quality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Execution-grounded signals substantially outperform pure semantic similarity for agent ranking
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lightweight behavioral signals close semantic-performance gap

title: Contexts are Never Long Enough: Structured Reasoning for Scalable Question Answering over Long Document Sets
task: Scalable question answering over long document collections via structured reasoning
key_results: Exceeds GPT-4 by 6.6 points on existing benchmarks; +19 and +32 points over baselines on new 3.9M and 36M token benchmarks
comments: SLIDERS elegantly sidesteps context-window limits through SQL reasoning on extracted structured data, but data reconciliation quality directly gates performance.

model_io.model: SLIDERS (LLM + information extraction + relational DB + SQL reasoning engine)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decomposing long-context QA into extracted structured state + SQL reasoning scales better than concatenated-text aggregation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with 6.6–32 point improvements across benchmarks

title: Building a Precise Video Language with Human-AI Oversight
task: High-precision video captioning and video generation control via human-AI critique oversight
key_results: Matches/exceeds closed-source models (Gemini-3.1-Pro); fine-tuned models follow detailed prompts (up to 400 words) with precise cinematography control
comments: Strong practical contribution with open datasets and human-in-the-loop quality control, but expert annotation cost and scalability to diverse video domains remain concerns.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Human critique quality (precision/recall/constructiveness) directly governs downstream video understanding and generation performance

task: Scalable robotic policy evaluation via discrete diffusion world models
key_results: Outperforms WorldEval, Ctrl-World, WorldGym on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and real-robot tasks; enables evaluation across thousands of environments/tasks
comments: Unified token-space architecture is elegant, but generalization to novel robot morphologies and real-world visual diversity is not thoroughly tested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified token-space diffusion world model scales policy evaluation better than modality-specific alternatives

key_results: Mid-training improves VLA performance across three benchmarks, achieving competitive results with expert VLAs; gains emerge from earliest fine-tuning steps

task: Memory management for long-horizon autonomous agents

key_results: Achieves power-law memory decay O(ℓ^{-β}) for 0 < β < 1; strongest long-context performance; competitive on short-context language modeling

key_results: Modular RAG framework with deterministic citation; achieves domain accuracy on constrained 1B-parameter models; enables low-resource deployment

key_results: DiagramBank curates 89,422 schematic diagrams from top-tier publications; CLIP-based filtering differentiates diagrams from plots; enables exemplar-conditioned teaser figure synthesis

key_results: Consistent improvement over prompt-based and prompt-optimization baselines on sequential recommendation and long-context QA; zero-shot transfer to different LLM sizes/APIs

task: Determine atomic structure and ion coordination mechanism of fungal TOK1 potassium channel
key_results: TOK1 features eight transmembrane helices with tetraspanin-like architecture distinct from known K⁺ channels; atypical K⁺ selectivity filter with unusual ion coordination; C-terminal cytosolic bundle likely stabilizes channel and mediates gating
comments: Novel channel architecture provides mechanistic insights into fungal ion homeostasis but functional validation of proposed gating mechanism through patch-clamp or computational studies would strengthen claims.

key_results: Identified 29 novel PALs from 23 Viola species; VdiPAL1 achieved 2× efficiency of wt-VyPAL2 with 12 mg/L soluble expression; VyOpt1 quintuple mutant showed 24-fold improved expression; broad P2″ specificity enables click-compatible liposome dual-functionalization

key_results: PebS achieved comparable PEB synthesis to canonical PebA-PebB; PcyX expression enhanced green-light growth by providing balanced pigment supply; PEB accumulation triggered upregulation of glucose metabolism and hydrogenase genes

hypotheses.hypothesis: PEB biosynthetic enzyme variants (pcyX, pebS) can fine-tune chromophore supply and enhance photosynthetic efficiency under specific light conditions

hypotheses.result: Supported by upregulation of glucose metabolism, hydrogenase, and regulatory genes

title: Pi4ka downregulation triggers Creb3l2-dependent lysosomal dysfunction to promote maladaptive tubular remodeling and immune activation in acute kidney injury
task: Pi4ka-mediated tubular homeostasis and immune activation in acute kidney injury
key_results: Pi4ka deficiency reduced in human diseased kidneys; impairs proximal tubule cell states (Slc34a1+Ccn1+, Slc34a1+Apob+), triggering lysosomal dysfunction via Creb3l2-dependent ER stress and immune activation; Creb3l2 deletion suppresses injury and pro-inflammatory programs
comments: The integration of single-cell transcriptomics with functional validation identifies a multilayered axis (Pi4ka-lysosome-Creb3l2) linking phospholipid metabolism to innate immunity in AKI, though in vivo therapeutic validation is pending.

model_io.model: mouse AKI models and proximal tubule cells (PTCs) with scRNA-seq

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pi4ka deficiency triggers Creb3l2-dependent lysosomal dysfunction linking tubular injury to immune activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Creb3l2 perturbation suppressed stress and cell-death programs while reversing pro-inflammatory phenotype

title: Epithelial SLC39A1 prevents acute lung injury through zinc-mediated transcriptional activation of autophagy in male mice
task: SLC39A1-mediated zinc-autophagy axis protection against acute lung injury
key_results: AT2-specific Slc39a1 deletion exacerbated lung injury; zinc supplementation alone failed to rescue Slc39a1-deficient mice; zinc activated TFEB/TFE3/MITF to induce Lc3b-dependent autophagy suppressing apoptosis/pyroptosis; Lc3b/Tfe3 deficiency heightened injury unmitigated by zinc, establishing epistatic relationship
comments: The epistatic analysis elegantly demonstrates that SLC39A1 functions upstream of TFEB/autophagy in a linear pathway, establishing a clear hierarchy for therapeutic targeting in ALI/ARDS.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SLC39A1 governs zinc uptake to activate TFEB/autophagy and suppress apoptosis/pyroptosis in AT2 cells

title: D-pinitol extends the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans through integrated antioxidant defense, proteostasis, and autophagy signaling
task: D-pinitol promotion of healthy aging via integrated antioxidant, proteostasis, and autophagy mechanisms
key_results: D-pinitol (200 μM) extended C. elegans mean lifespan by 28.6% with preserved locomotor function and delayed lipofuscin; attenuated proteotoxicity in Parkinson's, Huntington's, Alzheimer's models; activated Nrf2/SKN-1 and HSF-1 via p38 MAPK; enhanced HLH-30-dependent autophagy and mitophagy
comments: The lifespan extension is notable and mechanistically linked to evolutionarily conserved stress-response pathways, though the modest size of some phenotypic improvements and reliance on invertebrate models warrant follow-up in mammals.

model_io.model: C. elegans wild-type and proteotoxicity disease models; mammalian cell senescence assays

hypotheses.hypothesis: D-pinitol extends lifespan through p38 MAPK-dependent activation of Nrf2/SKN-1 and HSF-1 stress responses and HLH-30 autophagy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: DP activated stress regulators and enhanced autophagy/mitophagy; lifespan extension observed across models

title: Cancer-associated fibroblasts regulate DNA repair in pancreatic cancer through NDRG1-mediated R-loop processing
task: Mechanism of CAF-mediated chemoresistance in pancreatic cancer
key_results: NDRG1 mediates ECM-to-DNA repair signaling, resolving R-loops and replication fork stalling; high NDRG1 correlates with poor survival and chemotherapy resistance
comments: This work reveals an unexpected stromal contribution to intrinsic chemoresistance, positioning NDRG1 as both a mechanistic hub and potential therapeutic vulnerability.

outputs: NDRG1 expression and localization at replication forks

hypotheses.hypothesis: CAF-secreted ECM enhances DNA repair via NDRG1-dependent R-loop processing

title: The evolving landscape of CDK inhibitor use in breast cancer therapy and beyond
task: Clinical utility and prospects of CDK4/6 and CDK2 inhibitors in cancer therapy
key_results: CDK4/6 inhibitors approved only in breast cancer despite broader potential; new combinatorial approaches with HER2/PI3K inhibitors expand therapeutic scope; selective CDK2 inhibitors developed to overcome resistance; next-generation CDK4-selective inhibitors mitigate haematological toxicity; biomarkers emerging for patient selection
comments: This review synthesizes a decade of CDK inhibitor development, revealing that despite mechanistic promise, clinical translation remains limited to breast cancer, suggesting unmet needs in patient selection and combination strategies.

title: Patient specific regulation of metabolism and cell death pathways in m.3243A>G mutated iPS-cells
task: Patient-specific metabolic and cell death responses to m.3243A>G mitochondrial mutation in iPSCs
key_results: Despite similar heteroplasmy, P2 iPSCs showed reduced proliferation and glycolytic shift with BCL2-dependent apoptosis suppression and ferroptosis upregulation; P1 showed enhanced OXPHOS and proliferation with no cell death induction; ferroptosis inhibition rescued P2 proliferation
comments: This patient-specific iPSC modeling reveals that mitochondrial DNA heteroplasmy alone is insufficient to predict cellular phenotype, highlighting the importance of genetic background in disease manifestation and therapeutic response.

title: KDM8/c-Myc axis-mediated glucose metabolism reprogramming promotes the progression of ovarian cancer
task: KDM8/c-Myc axis-mediated glucose metabolism reprogramming in ovarian cancer progression
key_results: KDM8 and c-Myc directly interact and are upregulated in OC tissues; synergistically promote proliferation, migration, invasion, and glucose uptake/lactate accumulation; c-Myc knockdown attenuated KDM8-driven oncogenic effects; KDM8 function partially dependent on c-Myc in vivo

title: Morphological abnormalities in the ureter of type XVII collagen–deficient mice
task: Role of type XVII collagen in urothelial differentiation during postnatal development
key_results: Col17a1-KO mice showed shorter ureters, disorganized urothelium, loss of polarity, and lumen narrowing by 4 weeks; umbrella cells exhibited altered apical surfaces and reduced uroplakin 2; reduced Foxa1 expression persisted
comments: This work establishes COL17A1 as essential for urothelial maturation, though the specific molecular mechanisms linking hemidesmosomes to uroplakin regulation and epithelial differentiation remain incompletely defined.

hypotheses.hypothesis: COL17A1 is essential for urothelial differentiation during development

title: YKL-40 alleviates the TNF-α-Induced chondrocyte injury in osteoarthritis in vitro
task: YKL-40 protection of TNF-α-induced chondrocyte injury in osteoarthritis
key_results: YKL-40 (100 ng/mL) rescued TNF-α-induced ECM degradation (GAG and type II collagen loss); counteracted NF-κB pathway activation (reduced p65/IκBα phosphorylation); reversed TNF-α-induced S100A8/A9, ISG15 upregulation; serum YKL-40 and TNF-α elevated in OA patients vs. controls
comments: YKL-40 emerges as a protective factor countering TNF-α inflammation, though the therapeutic application requires clarification since elevated YKL-40 levels are associated with OA pathology.

model_io.model: TNF-α-treated chondrocytes and OA cartilage/synovium tissues

hypotheses.hypothesis: YKL-40 alleviates TNF-α-induced chondrocyte injury by inhibiting NF-κB pathway activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: YKL-40 suppressed p65 and IκBα phosphorylation and reversed TNF-α-induced gene expression changes

title: Meta-analysis of cellular phosphoproteome datasets exploring phospho-signaling associated with the RNA-binding protein RAVER1
task: Phospho-signaling networks regulating RAVER1 function in RNA processing and EMT
key_results: Identified 13 Class I RAVER1 phosphosites; S14, S17, T463 predominant; CDK9/12/13 predicted upstream kinases for S14; phosphoproteome-wide co-regulation linked to RNA processing, cell-cycle, DNA repair; EMT-associated genes (KDM1A, VIM, PTK2) showed positive co-regulation with RAVER1 phosphosites

title: Cancer-associated fibroblasts -derived Tenascin-C activates the Hippo/TAZ pathway to suppress ferroptosis and confer cisplatin resistance in esophageal cancer
task: CAF-derived Tenascin-C suppression of ferroptosis in esophageal cancer chemoresistance
key_results: CAF-derived TNC activates Hippo pathway, suppresses TAZ and ferroptosis markers, conferring cisplatin resistance; TNC/TAZ knockdown restores ferroptosis and drug sensitivity

title: Sodium butyrate protects against necrotizing enterocolitis through a mechanism involving YB-1-dependent regulation of intestinal epithelial apoptosis
task: Dose-dependent mechanism of sodium butyrate protection in necrotizing enterocolitis
key_results: Moderate butyrate (50 mg/kg) suppressed glycolysis and lactate, restoring PABPC1-mediated YB-1 synthesis to upregulate BCL-2 and inhibit apoptosis; high-dose (250 mg/kg) induced necroptosis/ferroptosis; exogenous lactate reversed protection

title: Gallic acid chemoprevention of oral carcinogenesis is associated with HSD11β2 upregulation and immune remodeling

key_results: GA selectively inhibited HNSCC cell proliferation while sparing normal epithelium; upregulated HSD11β2 and reduced cortisol in vitro/in vivo; increased IL-2, decreased IL-10, reduced monocytic MDSCs and PD-L1 on pro-inflammatory macrophages; activated Nrf2/SKN-1 and HSF-1
